## 1. Abstract & Formal Statement

Claim: a real Nullstellensatz certificate for the 180-residual ideal forces the Gram matrix of the 24 vectors of a putative quartet {I_6, F_6, B_3, B_4} to have a negative eigenvalue, so the variety is empty.

### Governing Obligation
No such certificate, Gram computation or emptiness proof is in the checkout; variety emptiness is the open part of gap G5.

### Witness Audit
The claim ledger evidence boundary states that NoCompleteMUB6, MUB(6)=3 and MUB(6)<=3 are not established.
